title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-06-15
content:
Week ending 2026-06-14 - Private Deployments engineering weekly update.

Summary:
- Focus this week: unblock two high-touch customer on-prem/VPC installs, stabilize automated installer for air-gapped environments, and ship initial KMS/HSM integration tests.
- Overall status: 2 high-priority customer blockers remain (Acme / FinBank), installer improvements in staging, KMS PoC passing basic flows but awaiting security review.

Highlights / Accomplishments:
- Installer: landed PR #432 to improve idempotency of config apply and add clearer rollback logging (see linked PR). Smoke tests in staging pass for common cluster topologies.
- KMS/HSM: added support for AWS CloudHSM and Azure Key Vault wrapped keys in the integration test harness. Basic key rotation worked in lab (Ethan).
- VPC docs: updated routing/peering troubleshooting doc with step-by-step for common route table / SG issues (Sofia).
- On-prem packaging: produced a new air-gapped tarball that embeds base images and offline Helm charts; initial install on partner lab succeeded (Marco).

Customer install status (high touch):
- Acme Corp (RDW-2248) - on-prem appliance install
  - Symptom: install fails during node agent registration; error shows TLS handshake failure with central control plane.
  - Root cause hypothesis: customer network blocks egress to third-party OCSP/CRL endpoints causing cert verification failures for intermediate CAs.
  - Actions this week: added verbose cert chain debug logging (PR 432) and provided a short script for Acme to run to capture TLS traces.
  - Blockers: awaiting network team runbook from Acme to confirm allowed egress endpoints. Solutions Eng session scheduled Tue 2026-06-16.
  - Owner: Priya (Solutions Eng), Support ticket: RDW-2248.

- FinBank (RDW-2301) - VPC peering + private networking
  - Symptom: control plane can reach customer VPC but cannot reach datastore endpoint (internal Postgres) due to missing route to the DB subnet.
  - Root cause: customer created a peering but did not add route for DB subnet to the cluster route table; VPN NAT rules also causing SNAT mismatches.
  - Actions: provided a minimal route table diff and VPN NAT example; engaged SRE to validate our peering test harness.
  - Blockers: FinBank security policy requires a vendor onboarding review before we can request temporary elevated routing changes. Estimated blocker resolution: ~3 business days after vendor review.
  - Owner: Marco (Solutions Eng) + SRE on-call.

Internal engineering work / tasks in progress:
- Installer idempotency and rollback (Aisha + Marco): target to merge remaining test fixes by 2026-06-18.
- Air-gap tarball automation (Marco): next step is to automate packaging pipeline; demo planned for 2026-06-21.
- KMS/HSM integration (Ethan + Sofia): add full CI matrix for AWS/Azure GCP and run through SOC checklist. Security review ticket opened RDW-2330.
- Observability: add more structured traces from registration flow to help with customer debugs (Liam).

Standup notes (daily short logs):
- Mon 2026-06-08: focused on reproducing Acme TLS issue in lab; reproduced cert validation fails when outbound CRL blocked. Started adding debug logging.
- Tue 2026-06-09: finalised KMS PoC key rotation tests; installer PR landed for better logging.
- Wed 2026-06-10: worked with SRE to reproduce FinBank peering; identified route table omission.
- Thu 2026-06-11: packaged air-gapped tarball for partner lab; confirmed install; started automation POC.
- Fri 2026-06-12: sprint planning + prioritized RDW-2248 and RDW-2301; scheduled Solutions Eng calls for next week.

Meeting notes - Private Deployments Sync 2026-06-14:
Attendees: Aisha Patel (eng), Marco Chen (solutions), Sofia Lopez (security), Ethan Wu (applied-ml/integration), Liam O'Connor (SRE), Priya Singh (solutions).
- Review customer blockers: Acme and FinBank discussed; agreed on immediate next steps (see customer install status).
- Installer health: agreed to backport idempotency fixes to the 1.4.x branch for Dedicated customers who can't upgrade yet.
- Security / KMS: Sofia requested a minimal audit log sample for the KMS flows; Ethan to provide by 2026-06-17.
- Observability: add a short-term tracing flag to enable verbose registration traces for single-customer debug sessions; Liam to implement feature toggle.
- Onboarding playbook: Solutions Eng to update the private-deployments onboarding checklist with a mandatory network egress test (checklist item added).

Action items with owners and due dates:
- Priya: Run Solutions Eng troubleshooting session with Acme on Tue 2026-06-16 and collect network runbook. (Due 2026-06-16)
- Marco: Prepare air-gap packaging automation demo and runbook for partner installs. (Due 2026-06-21)
- Aisha: Merge remaining installer idempotency test fixes and backport to 1.4.x branch. (Due 2026-06-18)
- Ethan: Deliver KMS audit log sample and updated integration test output for security review RDW-2330. (Due 2026-06-17)
- Liam: Implement trace feature toggle for registration and coordinate with support to enable for Acme. (Due 2026-06-16)
- Sofia: Kick off security review for KMS flows and list any missing artifacts. (Due 2026-06-19)

Risks and escalation:
- If Acme cannot allow egress to CRL/OCSP endpoints, we need to ship a cached CRL mechanism or provide a signed cert bundle; this is a moderate effort and could push timelines by 2-3 weeks.
- FinBank vendor onboarding delays are out of our control; escalate to account manager if no progress by 2026-06-20.

Notes / follow-ups:
- Add a short troubleshooting script to the onboarding repo that captures TLS traces, route table screenshots, and a minimal k8s diagnostics bundle (Marco + Aisha).
- Update the onboarding Confluence page with the new network egress checklist and link it in solutions runbooks.

Attachments / quick links:
- Installer PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/pull/432
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/On-Prem+Installer+Design
- Tickets: RDW-2248 (Acme), RDW-2301 (FinBank), RDW-2330 (KMS security review)

Overall plan for next week:
- Short-term: unblock Acme with debug session and traces; enable trace toggle to gather telemetry. Backport critical installer fixes.
- Mid-term: automate air-gap packaging and finalize KMS security artifacts.

If urgent escalations are needed, contact Aisha Patel or Marco Chen.
